title: Furniture and furnishings (movable)
status: Movable items, in sections of their own: Furniture and Soft furnishings, on for Interiors and off for Repair and for a new house, as Appliances and Smart home are (the owner, D-UX-19). Lenders treat them apart from fixed works. Where the library has nothing above a level yet, its highest item stands for the levels above, and its note says so.
